# How to cards of release 41: sources and licences

Four cards, 1600 x 840, JPEG quality 84, for the how tos of the README added with build 41 and desktop build 21, and its translations (the same files in every language: the pictures carry names only, no sentence). Made on 4 November 2026 the way the use case cards of `../usecases/` were made (see "Use case cards" in `../CAPTURES.md`): at the top, an illustration generated for the project with an AI image model, from a written description, with the picture of the opening image (without its words) as its style reference, showing no screen of the app, no text, no logo or brand of another company and no face; under it, a row drawn by a script outside the repository, with line pictograms, arrows, labels set in Inter (SIL Open Font License 1.1), the app's own icon on each device that runs Immuch360 and, on three cards, the platform logos of `../logos/` on white chips (see `../logos/SOURCES.md`). No card holds a capture of the app.

| File | README section | Scene | Row | Other picture in it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `splat-viewer.jpg` | Explore Gaussian splats on your phone, tablet or computer | a living room at night: a person seen from behind holds a phone, a laptop on a low table shows the same room, a storage box on a shelf; two specks on the bezels filled from their neighbours | a splat, a NAS, an Android phone and a computer (Android, Windows, Linux and macOS logos) | none |
| `splat-maker.jpg` | Make a splat scene from your photos or a video (AI) | a workroom at night: printed photos around a stone owl, a laptop that shows the owl rebuilt, a headset on a side table; one faint bar on the laptop's bezel filled from its neighbours | photos around an object, a Windows computer, a NAS, a Meta Quest 3 or 3S (Windows and Meta logos) | none |
| `splat-photo.jpg` | Keep a splat scene on your Immich server | a living room at dusk: a home server, a TV that shows one photo with a small 3D mark, a phone, a person seen from behind in a headset before the same room; the arc of light toward the headset redrawn from the server, as the generated picture drew it from the TV | a splat, an Immich server, a TV, a phone and a headset (Google TV, Android and Meta logos) | the photo on the TV of the row is a crop of this card's own generated picture |
| `av2-on-computer.jpg` | Play AV2 videos on your computer | a study at night: a person seen from behind watches a film of a lighthouse on a laptop, a storage box on a shelf; one faint mark on the laptop's bezel filled from its neighbours | a video tile with its AV2 badge, a laptop, the details line "Video decoding" (no platform logo) | the frame at 45 s of "Orbit around Fremantle South Mole Lighthouse at sunset.webm" by JamesBromberger, [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/), CC0 1.0, in the tile and on the laptop of the row |
